about: Timeline path 2 of 3, 'Correspondence' (docs/research/2026-10-01-timeline-brainstorm.md): the lines as a lookup table, the Western occult reading, King Wen to today. Opens on all three paths and flies down this one. Draft 2, Sol's rewrite of pages and caption (docs/research/2026-10-04-codex-timeline-binary-correspondence.md); page 1 keeps Answering's opener so the three paths open alike. Draft 1, from Sol's checked table (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-timeline-paths.md). Wang Bi and Watts left out (the user, 2026-10-04: 'i thought wang bi wasn't really divination at all?'; Wang Bi closes the Answering path instead).
style: The header reads '8-BIT ORACLE // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout (brand.header). Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

pages.q: AN OLD BOOK AND A NEW MACHINE
pages.a:
BINARY. CORRESPONDENCE.
WHO IS ANSWERING?
FOLLOW THE SECOND PATH.

64 HEXAGRAMS: SIX LINES EACH.
THEIR ORDER AND SHORT TEXTS
ARE CREDITED TO HIM.

HE WRITES LIBER TRIGRAMMATON:
27 FIGURES, THREE POSITIONS:
EACH SOLID, BROKEN OR A DOT.

EIGHT THREE-LINE PATTERNS
LINK TO KABBALAH. HE ALSO
LISTS THE 64 HEXAGRAM MEANINGS.

HIS GERMAN I-CHING APPEARS,
WITH HELP FROM THE SCHOLAR
LAO NAIXUAN.

HE SEES A MEANINGFUL MATCH
BETWEEN AN I-CHING ANSWER
AND A PERSON'S STATE OF MIND.

FROM KING WEN'S ORDER
OF THE 64 THEY BUILD
A SPECULATIVE MAP OF TIME.

HIS MATRIX TRANSLATION
LISTS ALTERNATIVE ENGLISH
MEANINGS FOR CHINESE WORDS.

A LANGUAGE MODEL USES
LEARNED TABLES OF NUMBERS
FOR WORDS AND WORD PIECES.
